passageHtml:
Document 1: E-mail

To: Marcus Bell, Regional Operations Manager, Harlow & Finch
From: Priya Raman, Project Manager, Calder Construction
Date: April 14
Subject: Store 27 renovation — revised schedule

Dear Mr. Bell,

The electrical permit for the Store 27 project was issued three days later than expected, which has shifted part of our schedule. The removal of the old shelving will still take place from April 20 to 22. However, installation of the new checkout counters will now occur on May 4 and 5 rather than April 29 and 30. The new shelving will be installed on May 6 and 7, and the final inspection is set for May 11. We will hand the store back to you on May 12.

The store can remain open throughout the work, which will be carried out between 7:00 a.m. and 3:00 p.m. Aisle 7 will be closed while the old shelving is removed, and our crew will use loading dock 2 from April 20 through May 8. Please ask your receiving staff to use dock 1 during that period.

Regards,
Priya Raman

Document 2: Internal Memo

To: All Store 27 Staff
From: Marcus Bell, Regional Operations Manager
Date: April 16
Subject: Renovation updates and reopening plans

As Calder Construction explained, the store will stay open, but our checkout area will be affected. On May 4 and 5, while the new counters are being installed, all checkout operations will move temporarily to the garden center. Please direct customers there and allow extra time for transactions.

The handover date is now May 12. We will use the following four days to restock and merchandise the sales floor, so the loyalty-member reopening event will be held on May 16. Members will receive 20 percent off a single regular-priced item, and the promotion will run through May 18.

All cashiers must complete the 45-minute online module on the new registers by May 10, and then attend one hands-on session on May 13, either at 8:00 a.m. or at 2:00 p.m. Because the store will not be returned to us until May 12, we could not arrange these sessions any earlier.

The seasonal display normally located in aisle 7 has been moved to aisle 12 until the shelving work is finished. Finally, all deliveries from April 20 through May 8 must be sent to dock 1, since dock 2 will be reserved for the contractor.

Marcus
questionText: According to the two documents, why will customers pay at the garden center on May 4 and 5?

options.text: (A) The main checkout area is being repainted.
(B) New checkout counters are being installed.
(C) The garden center is holding a seasonal sale.
(D) A final safety inspection is taking place.

translation: Theo hai tài liệu, vì sao khách hàng sẽ thanh toán tại khu vườn vào ngày 4 và 5 tháng 5? — Vì các quầy thu ngân mới đang được lắp đặt.
explanation: Đáp án B. Tài liệu 1 cho biết việc lắp đặt quầy thu ngân mới diễn ra vào ngày 4 và 5 tháng 5 (“installation of the new checkout counters will now occur on May 4 and 5”). Tài liệu 2 giải thích rằng trong thời gian đó, toàn bộ hoạt động thanh toán tạm chuyển sang khu vườn (“all checkout operations will move temporarily to the garden center”). A sai vì không có việc sơn lại quầy. C sai vì khu vườn chỉ là địa điểm thanh toán tạm, không có chương trình khuyến mãi. D sai vì kiểm tra cuối cùng diễn ra ngày 11 tháng 5, không phải ngày 4-5.

To: Thomas Park, Director of Financial Planning
From: Aisha Bello, Senior Financial Analyst
Date: May 6
Subject: Approval requested — Midwest Forecasting Conference

Dear Mr. Park,

I would like to attend the Midwest Forecasting Conference in Chicago on June 10 and 11. The early-bird registration fee is $895 until May 23, after which the standard fee is $1,050. I am asking for your approval by May 20 so that I can register at the lower rate.

The conference hotel has quoted a rate of $210 per night, and I have reserved a room for the nights of June 9, 10, and 11. My original plan was to return on June 12. Because I would like to visit my family in Chicago, I would also like to stay on June 12 and 13 and fly home on June 14. I understand that those two extra nights, as well as the $75 change fee and the $40 fare difference for the later flight, will be my responsibility.

The round-trip economy airfare is $410. For the trip from O'Hare Airport to the hotel, the airport shuttle costs $32 one way, while a rideshare is estimated at $55.

Please let me know whether you approve. I will keep all itemized receipts and file my expense report after I return.

Best regards,
Aisha Bello
questionText: Why does Ms. Bello ask for approval by May 20?

options.text: (A) The hotel's conference rate expires on that date.
(B) Her manager will be out of the office after that date.
(C) She must receive approval before registering at the lower fee.
(D) The airline requires 14 days' notice for ticket changes.

translation: Vì sao bà Bello xin phê duyệt trước ngày 20 tháng 5? — Vì bà phải được phê duyệt trước khi đăng ký với mức phí thấp hơn.
explanation: Đáp án C. Chính sách quy định phí hội nghị chỉ được hoàn khi người lao động được quản lý phê duyệt trước (“approved in advance by the employee's department manager”), và nên tận dụng giá đăng ký sớm. E-mail cho biết giá ưu đãi 895 đô-la hết hạn ngày 23 tháng 5, nên bà xin phê duyệt trước ngày 20 để kịp đăng ký mức giá thấp. A sai vì không có thông tin giá khách sạn hết hạn ngày 20. B không được đề cập. D sai vì quy định đặt vé trước 14 ngày không liên quan đến hạn phê duyệt.

LINDEN & CO. HOME GOODS — CUSTOMER INSIGHTS REPORT

Prepared by the Retail Analytics Team • July 15

Between March 1 and May 31, Linden & Co. conducted a three-month pilot of the digital Linden Rewards loyalty program at four stores in the Metro North district. Shoppers enrolled through the Linden mobile app and earned points on every qualifying purchase.

As detailed in the attached performance table, the pilot exceeded our overall enrollment target and drove substantial growth in both basket size and house-brand sales. However, post-pilot surveys revealed two barriers to wider adoption: 1) shoppers over age 60 were reluctant to download a mobile app at the checkout counter, and 2) several cashiers felt rushed when explaining the point-redemption rules during busy weekend hours.

MEMORANDUM
To: Regional Store Directors
From: Executive Committee
Date: July 18
Subject: Company-Wide Rollout of Linden Rewards (September 1)

Based on the strong pilot results in Metro North, the Executive Committee has approved a company-wide rollout of Linden Rewards across all 42 stores on September 1, backed by an $85,000 launch budget.
